title: Make Live Turn sticky CSS regression assertion order-independent
outcome: The AgentSessionPanel regression test parses the .conversation-live-tail.is-pinned CSS rule with an order-dependent regular expression. Replace it with a small declaration-block assertion that validates position: sticky and bottom: 0 regardless of formatting or declaration order, while retaining the unpinned base-rule guard.
disposal_reason: Obsolete. The owner's clarification (note 9eaf9dce) superseded the sticky requirement: the LIVE TURN must NOT be sticky. The current AgentSessionPanel.test.tsx:814-826 forbids sticky, fixed or absolute positioning on the queued tail, so an order-independent sticky-CSS assertion no longer has a requirement to test. Do not reintroduce sticky. Evidence: Sol-a7bb's triage (f59d4581 #344, item 18), under Greg's net-reduction directive.
